content.short: Parasol provides an agile smart contract development environment.
content.description: Parasol is an agile smart contract development environment designed to streamline Solidity workflows. It includes Mocha-based testing, Infura deployment, and automatic Markdown documentation for contracts. The tool prioritizes a flexible, unopinionated design with unlimited customization, and it incorporates a Solidity preprocessor to enhance coding and build processes. Together, these features support rapid iteration while preserving developer autonomy and control.
